confidence_meaning.measured: the dataset's own labels carry the published name and the cited paper describes that population in a male
confidence_meaning.uncertain: the name sits on two distinct types, the count disagrees with the paper, the annotators' labels disagree with each other, or the role was shown only in females; shown on the page with this word

DA1_PN.citation: Datta et al. 2008 Nature 452:473 (DA1 projection neurons, dimorphic targets); Ruta et al. 2010 Nature 468:686; figure not verified in this session. Identity: type names DA1_lPN, DA1_vPN.
DA1_PN.name: DA1 PN
DA1_PN.role: cVA projection neurons (DA1 glomerulus to lateral horn)

DC1.citation: Ruta et al. 2010 Nature 468:686 (DC1 receive DA1 PN input and are tuned to cVA); figure not verified in this session. Identity: the annotators' synonyms column tags these 8 types 'Ruta 2010: DC1'.
DC1.name: DC1

DNa01.citation: Chen et al. 2018 Nat Commun 9:4390 and Rayshubskiy et al. 2020 describe DNa01 as a steering neuron; the roamer reads it as forward. Identity: type DNa01.
DNa01.name: DNa01
DNa01.role: forward walking descending neurons (the roamer's reading)

DNa02.citation: Rayshubskiy et al. 2020 bioRxiv 2020.04.04.024703 (DNa02 steering); the roamer's mapping, pumpui.FlyPilot. Identity: type DNa02.
DNa02.name: DNa02
DNa02.note: DNae001 carries hemibrainType DNa01 and DNp71 carries hemibrainType DNp09; both are excluded, as in the roamer, which matches the type name exactly.

DNp09.citation: Bidaye et al. 2020 Neuron 108:469 (DNp09 drives forward walking, freezing at strong activation); the roamer reads it as stop. Identity: type DNp09.
DNp09.name: DNp09
DNp09.role: forward-walking descending neurons that freeze the fly at strong activation; read as stop by the roamer

DNp13.citation: Ruta et al. 2010 Nature 468:686 (DN1, described there as a male-specific descending neuron excited by DC1 and responding to cVA); Kimura et al. 2015 PLoS ONE 10:e0126445 (pMN1, dsx+, ovipositor extension in females); Mezzera et al. 2020 Curr Biol 30:3736 (DNp13 = pMN1 drives full ovipositor extrusion in females); figure not verified in this session. Identity: type DNp13, whose synonyms column reads 'Kimura 2015: pMN1; Ruta 2010: DN1'; the annotators' dimorphism label is 'sexually dimorphic' (present in both sexes), not male-specific.
DNp13.name: DNp13 (Ruta 2010 DN1)
DNp13.note: The tag says a male-specific cVA descending neuron (Ruta 2010), the annotators' dimorphism label says sexually dimorphic, and the best-documented role of pMN1 / DNp13 is a female motor command (Mezzera 2020): the paper and the labels disagree, so the group is labelled uncertain.
DNp13.role: dsx+ descending neuron tagged Ruta 2010 DN1 (cVA pathway); pMN1, the ovipositor-extrusion command in females (Mezzera 2020)

JO_A.citation: Kamikouchi et al. 2009 Nature 458:165 (subgroups A and B respond to vibration, C and E to static deflection); Yorozu et al. 2009 Nature 458:201; figure not verified in this session. Identity: type names JO-A1..A4 and JO-A-unclear.
JO_A.name: JO-A
JO_A.note: Antennal cells: no somaSide; rootSide L 18, R 32. The annotators' subclass calls 49 of the 50 'auditory' and 1 'wind_gravity'. This is the group the room drives with the other fly's song.
JO_A.role: sound-sensitive Johnston's organ neurons, subgroup A

JO_B.citation: Kamikouchi et al. 2009 Nature 458:165; Yorozu et al. 2009 Nature 458:201; figure not verified in this session. Identity: type names JO-B1_a..B4_b and JO-B-unclear.
JO_B.name: JO-B
JO_B.note: Antennal cells: no somaSide; rootSide L 60, R 29. The annotators' subclass calls 54 of the 89 'auditory', 34 'wind_gravity' and leaves 1 blank; the group follows the type name, as the FACTS do. The annotators' labels disagree with each other on 35 of 89 cells, so the group is labelled uncertain.
JO_B.role: sound-sensitive Johnston's organ neurons, subgroup B

LC1.citation: Ruta et al. 2010 Nature 468:686; figure not verified in this session. Identity: the annotators' synonyms column tags these 3 types 'Ruta 2010: LC1'.
LC1.name: LC1

LC10a.citation: Ribeiro et al. 2018 Cell 174:607 (LC10 silencing abolishes orientation toward and pursuit of the female); Hindmarsh Sten et al. 2021 Nature 595:549 (LC10a, gated by P1); figure not verified in this session. Identity: type name LC10a.
LC10a.name: LC10a
LC10a.note: LC10b, LC10c-1/2, LC10d, LC10e and LoVP76 (LC10f) exist too (689 more cells) and are not named, since the courtship evidence is for LC10a.
LC10a.role: small-object tracking visual projection neurons used in courtship pursuit, fru+

MDN.citation: Bidaye et al. 2014 Science 344:97 (MDN). Identity: type MDN (synonym 'Carreira-Rosario 2018: DNp50').
MDN.name: MDN

ORN_DA1.citation: Kurtovic, Widmer & Dickson 2007 Nature 446:542 (Or67d neurons respond to cVA); Couto, Alenius & Dickson 2005 Curr Biol 15:1535 (Or67d projects to DA1); figure not verified in this session. Identity: the type name ORN_DA1.
ORN_DA1.name: ORN_DA1
ORN_DA1.note: Cell bodies are in the antenna, so there is no somaSide; the annotators' rootSide gives R 105, L 51, unknown 48. This is the group the room drives with the other fly's presence.
ORN_DA1.role: cVA pheromone receptor neurons (Or67d, glomerulus DA1)

P1.citation: Kimura et al. 2008 Neuron 59:759 (P1); von Philipsborn et al. 2011 Neuron 69:509 (P1 activation drives song; figure not verified in this session); Hoopfer et al. 2015 eLife 4:e11346 Fig. 1 (P1, 'also known as pMP4/-e', activation promotes wing extension and aggression); Inagaki et al. 2014 Nat Methods 11:325. Identity: the 25 pC1 subtypes the annotators tag 'Cachero 2010: pMP-e; Yu 2010: pMP4'.
P1.name: P1
P1.note: 86 cells here (43 per side) against about 20 per hemisphere in Kimura 2008, so the tag covers more cells than the published P1 cluster; named with the label 'uncertain'.
P1.role: courtship command neurons (P1 = pMP4 = pMP-e), fru+ dsx+

P1_by_name.citation: The only 'P1' string is hemibrainType 'P1-9' on OA-AL2i1, an octopaminergic optic-lobe type, unrelated. P1 is reachable only through the pC1 subtypes tagged pMP-e/pMP4 (group 'P1').
P1_by_name.name: P1 (by name)

PPN1.citation: Kallman, Kim & Scott 2015 eLife 4:e11188; figure not verified in this session. Identity: the annotators' synonyms column tags AN05B102a 'Kallman 2015: PPN1'.
PPN1.name: PPN1
PPN1.role: pheromone processing neuron of the leg-to-brain pathway

TN1A.citation: Lillvis et al. 2024 Curr Biol 34:808 Fig. 2 (TN1A necessary and sufficient for sine song); Shiozaki et al. 2024 Nat Neurosci 27:1954 Fig. 1 and 3. Identity: mancType TN1a (types TN1a_a..i).
TN1A.name: TN1A
TN1A.note: TN1c_a..d (13 cells, mancType TN1c) are not in the cited figures and are left out.
TN1A.role: sine-song premotor neurons (also active during pulse)

Tk_FruM.citation: Asahina et al. 2014 Cell 156:221 Fig. 2 (about 4 male-specific Tk-GAL4^FruM cells per hemisphere in the lateral protocerebrum; activation promotes aggression) and Fig. 3 (no effect on courtship). Identity: the annotators' synonyms column tags AVLP727m 'Asahina 2014: TK-FruM'.
Tk_FruM.name: Tk-FruM
Tk_FruM.note: 5 cells here, 3 left and 2 right, against 4.2 +/- 0.8 per hemisphere (about 8 in all) in the paper: the count disagrees with the paper, so the group is labelled uncertain.

aDN.citation: Types 'ADNM1 MN' and 'ADNM2 MN' are abdominal motor neurons (mancType ADNM1/2), not a courtship descending neuron.
aDN.name: aDN (courtship descending)
aDN.role: no courtship type is named aDN

aIPg.citation: Schretter et al. 2020 eLife 9:e58942 Fig. 1 (aIPg activation raises female aggression) and Fig. 5 (aIPg in the EM volume); Cachero et al. 2010 Curr Biol 20:1589 (aIP-g, fru+, dimorphic). Identity: type names aIPg1..aIPg10 and aIPg_m1..m4.
aIPg.name: aIPg
aIPg.note: Schretter 2020 saw no expression of two aIPg lines in males and no male effect, so the role is female evidence only.
aIPg.role: aggression neurons (shown in females; fru+ in this male, male role not shown)

dMS2.citation: Lillvis et al. 2024 Curr Biol 34:808 Fig. 2 (dMS2 necessary and sufficient for sine song). Identity: type and mancType dMS2 (synonym 'Yu 2010, Lillvis 2024: dMS2').
dMS2.name: dMS2

dMS9.citation: Lillvis et al. 2024 Curr Biol 34:808 Fig. 3 (dMS9 required for pulse song). Identity: type and mancType dMS9 (synonym 'Lillvis 2024: dMS9').
dMS9.name: dMS9

dPR1.citation: von Philipsborn et al. 2011 Neuron 69:509 (dPR1; figure not verified in this session); Lillvis et al. 2024 Curr Biol 34:808 Fig. 3; Shiozaki et al. 2024 Nat Neurosci 27:1954 Fig. 1 (pulse-selective). Identity: mancType dPR1 on one type and the synonym 'Yu 2010, Lillvis 2024: dPr1' on IN08B001.
dPR1.name: dPR1
dPR1.note: The dataset carries the name on two distinct types (2 cells each); both are included and the group is labelled uncertain.

mAL.citation: Kimura et al. 2005 Nature 438:229 (mAL, fru+, male-enlarged); Clowney et al. 2015 Neuron 87:1036 Fig. 3-4 (mAL inhibition converges on P1); Kallman, Kim & Scott 2015 eLife 4:e11188. Identity: type names mAL_m1..m11 (fru_high, male-specific).
mAL.name: mAL
mAL.note: Types mAL4A..mAL6, mALB*, mALD* (hemibrain lineage names, no fru label, synonym 'mAL') are left out.
mAL.role: fru+ GABAergic neurons inhibiting P1 (contact pheromone pathway)

pC1.citation: Rideout et al. 2010 Nat Neurosci 13:458 (pC1 dsx cluster); Nojima et al. 2021 Curr Biol 31:2276; Sten et al. 2025 (pC1x); figure not verified in this session. Identity: type names pC1_* and pC1x_* (not LPC1/LLPC1, which are optic-lobe types).
pC1.name: pC1
pC1.role: dsx+ male courtship and aggression command cluster (contains P1)

pC2_by_name.citation: pC2l exists only as the annotators' synonym on 16 types (group 'pC2l').
pC2_by_name.name: pC2 (by name)

pC2l.citation: Deutsch et al. 2019 eLife 8:e49890 (pC2l respond to courtship song); figure not verified in this session. Identity: the annotators' synonyms column tags 37 cells on 16 types 'Nojima 2021: pC2l'; the 9 types tagged on every cell are listed (20 cells).
pC2l.name: pC2l
pC2l.note: No type is named pC2; the name exists only as a per-cell synonym on 16 AVLP/PVLP/SIP types, 7 of them tagged on only some cells (left out, 17 tagged cells lost). Labelled uncertain for that spread.

pCd.citation: Jung et al. 2020 Neuron 105:322 (male pCd neurons respond to cVA and are required for P1-evoked persistent courtship and aggression; figure not verified in this session); Zhou et al. 2014 Neuron 83:149 (the name pCd: a dsx+ cluster studied there for female receptivity; the source of the annotators' tag, not of the male role). Identity: the annotators' synonyms column tags 66 cells on 16 types 'Zhou 2014: pCd' (Rideout 2010 pC3; Nojima 2021 pCd-1, pCd-2); the 13 types tagged on every cell are listed (62 cells).
pCd.name: pCd
pCd.note: The tag is spread over many types including one descending neuron (DNpe034, mancType oviDN), is per cell rather than per type on three of them (those are left out, 4 tagged cells lost), and the annotators split it into pCd-1 and pCd-2. Labelled uncertain for that spread. The name comes from a female study (Zhou 2014); the male role is Jung 2020.
pCd.role: dsx+ cluster; in males cVA-responsive and required for P1-evoked persistent courtship and aggression

pIP10.citation: von Philipsborn et al. 2011 Neuron 69:509 (pIP10; figure not verified in this session); Lillvis et al. 2024 Curr Biol 34:808 Fig. 4; Shiozaki et al. 2024 Nat Neurosci 27:1954 Fig. 6. Identity: type and mancType pIP10 (synonyms: Kimura 2008 P2b, Cachero 2010 pIP-a, Yu 2010 pIP1).
pIP10.name: pIP10
pIP10.role: song descending neuron (drives both pulse and sine song)

pMP2.citation: Lillvis et al. 2024 Curr Biol 34:808 Fig. 3 (pMP2 required for pulse song); Shiozaki et al. 2024 Nat Neurosci 27:1954 Fig. 6 (pulse-selective). Identity: type and mancType pMP2.
pMP2.name: pMP2

song_ps1.citation: Shirangi, Stern & Truman 2013 Cell Rep 5:678 Fig. 4; Lillvis et al. 2024 Curr Biol 34:808 Fig. 8D. Identity: type 'ps1 MN'.
song_ps1.name: ps1 MN
song_ps1.role: pulse-song wing motor neuron (pleurosternal muscle ps1)

song_pulse_mn.citation: Shirangi, Stern & Truman 2013 Cell Rep 5:678 Fig. 4 (inhibiting the ps1 motoneuron lowers pulse carrier frequency and amplitude, sine song intact); Lillvis et al. 2024 Curr Biol 34:808 Fig. 8D (ps1, i1, iii1 and b3 are innervated by pulse-specific neurons). Identity: MANC motor-neuron type names 'ps1 MN', 'i1 MN', 'iii1 MN', 'b3 MN' (subclass wm).
song_pulse_mn.name: pulse-song wing motor neurons
song_pulse_mn.note: This is the group the room reads as the fly's song. The evidence for i1, iii1 and b3 is wiring (Fig. 8D); for ps1 it is silencing (Shirangi 2013 Fig. 4).
song_pulse_mn.role: wing motor neurons wired from pulse-song premotor neurons

song_sine_hg1.citation: Shirangi, Stern & Truman 2013 Cell Rep 5:678 Fig. 1 (hg1 is male-enlarged) and Fig. 2 (silencing the hg1 motoneuron removes sine song, pulse song intact). Identity: type 'hg1 MN'.
song_sine_hg1.name: hg1 MN
song_sine_hg1.note: The build's FACTS listed hg1 with ps1 as pulse-song motor neurons; Shirangi 2013 assigns hg1 to sine song, so hg1 is kept out of the pulse group and named here as sine.
song_sine_hg1.role: sine-song wing motor neuron (male-enlarged muscle hg1)

vAB3.citation: Clowney et al. 2015 Neuron 87:1036 Fig. 2-3 (vAB3 excitation onto P1). Identity: the annotators' synonyms column tags these 3 types 'Yu 2010: vAB3' (one also 'von Philipsborn 2011: vAB3').
vAB3.name: vAB3
vAB3.role: ascending pheromone neurons exciting P1 (ppk25 foreleg input)

vMS11.citation: von Philipsborn et al. 2011 Neuron 69:509 (vMS11; figure not verified in this session). Identity: type and mancType vMS11.
vMS11.name: vMS11
vMS11.note: The published vMS11 is fru+; the 14 cells named vMS11 here carry no fruDsx label, so the match is labelled uncertain.

vMS12.citation: Lillvis et al. 2024 Curr Biol 34:808 Fig. 3 (required for pulse song) and Fig. 8D (ps1 receives its input mainly from vMS12). Identity: mancType vMS12 (types vMS12_a..e; synonym 'Cachero 2010: vMs-m').
vMS12.name: vMS12
vMS12.role: pulse-song premotor neurons that drive the ps1 wing motor neuron

vPR6.citation: von Philipsborn et al. 2011 Neuron 69:509 (vPR6; figure not verified in this session); Lillvis et al. 2024 Curr Biol 34:808 supplementary figures. Identity: type and mancType vPR6.
vPR6.name: vPR6
vPR6.role: song premotor neurons (pulse timing in von Philipsborn 2011; not part of the core circuit in Lillvis 2024)

vPR9.citation: Lillvis et al. 2024 Curr Biol 34:808 Fig. 5-6; Shiozaki et al. 2024 Nat Neurosci 27:1954 Extended Data Fig. 8. Identity: mancType vPR9 (types vPR9_a..c) and the synonym 'Yu 2010, Lillvis 2024: vPR9' on IN00A017.
vPR9.name: vPR9
vPR9.note: Two labels on distinct types, and the vPR9_* cells carry no somaSide (midline cells).
vPR9.role: GABAergic song neurons acting on both song modes

vpoDN.citation: Wang et al. 2021 Nature 589:577 (vpoDN). vpoEN and vpoIN types exist here (fru+), vpoDN does not.
vpoDN.name: vpoDN
vpoDN.role: female vaginal-plate-opening descending neuron; not in a male

wing_mn_all.citation: MANC nomenclature: Takemura et al. 2024 eLife 13:RP97769 and Cheong et al. 2024 eLife 13:RP96084 (male adult nerve cord); Azevedo et al. 2024 Nature 631:360 (wing motor neurons of the female VNC). Identity: vnc_motor types with subclass 'wm'.
wing_mn_all.name: wing motor neurons
wing_mn_all.note: One wm cell has an empty type string and is left out. The room falls back to this group for the song only if the pulse group were absent; it is not.
wing_mn_all.role: all named wing motor neurons (steering and power muscles)

motor_readout.DNp09: stop (the roamer's reading; Bidaye 2020 shows forward walking, freezing only at strong activation)

types_syntax: an entry starting with '^' is a regular expression matched against the whole type string; any other entry is an exact type name
what: Which neurons the backrooms page may name, on whose authority, and how many of them this dataset holds. Counts are measured from build/graph.npz and data/body-annotations.feather; identities and role words are chosen and cited per entry.
